invariants.rationale: The method always returns WriteHelperHolder.JAVA_WRITE_HELPER, which must not be null to avoid NullPointerExceptions and to be a valid singleton.
By method body, result is always the static singleton WriteHelperHolder.JAVA_WRITE_HELPER.
The declared return value and singleton object are instances of JavaWriteHelper.
The static field used as the singleton must be initialized and non-null for the method to function properly.
